newsitem.title: USA: Frontera, Baker Hughes in Azerbaijan alliance.
newsitem.headline: Frontera, Baker Hughes in Azerbaijan alliance.

text.p: Privately-held Frontera Resources Corp said it has formed an alliance with Baker Hughes Solutions, a unit of Baker Hughes Inc to exploit a block in the onshore Kura Basin in Azerbaijan.

"Frontera is already in discussions with the State Oil Company of the Azerbaijan Republic (SOCAR) regarding the development of onshore projects," said Frontera's president and chief executive officer Steve Nicandros.
The alliance will allow joint technical studies in the basin 's onshore Kura Basin.
Frontera already operates a 1.4-million-acre Kura Basin block in Georgia, on that nation's border with Azerbaijan. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
